# 🔤 FontEF Pro ### Professional Font Manager Module for KernelSU [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-1.0-6366f1?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/DeZ4p/fontef-pro/releases) [![KernelSU](https://img.shields.io/badge/KernelSU-Module-10b981?style=for-the-badge)](https://kernelsu.org) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-@DeZ4p-06b6d4?style=for-the-badge)](https://t.me/DeZ4p) --- **Change your Android system font with a beautiful WebUI**
## ✨ Features - 🎯 Universal font replacement for ALL Android devices - 🌐 Online WebUI (always up-to-date) - 🌙 Auto Dark / Light theme - 🔍 Universal root bridge (works on all devices) - 📱 meta-overlayfs support - 🛡️ susfs4ksu compatible - 🔄 Remote config updates (no reinstall needed) - 👁️ Live font preview with size control - 📊 Device info display - 💾 Backup and Restore - 🗑️ Complete uninstall cleanup (zero traces) ## 🌍 Supported Languages 🇺🇸 English | 🇮🇷 فارسی | 🇸🇦 العربية | 🇷🇺 Русский | 🇮🇩 Indonesia | 🇮🇳 हिंदी | 🇹🇷 Türkçe | 🇩🇪 Deutsch ## 📱 Supported Devices - Xiaomi / Poco / Redmi (MIUI, HyperOS) - Samsung (One UI) - OnePlus / Oppo / Realme (OxygenOS, ColorOS) - Google Pixel (Pixel UI) - Huawei / Honor (EMUI, HarmonyOS) - TECNO / Infinix (HiOS) - Any AOSP / Custom ROM (LineageOS, crDroid, PixelOS) ## 📥 Installation 1. Download the latest ZIP from [Releases](../../releases) 2. Open KernelSU app 3. Install module (flash ZIP) 4. Reboot your device 5. Open KernelSU → Modules → FontEF Pro → WebUI 6. Upload a font file (.ttf or .otf) 7. Tap Apply Font 8. Reboot again ## 🔄 Auto Update FontEF Pro supports KernelSU auto-update. The module automatically checks for new versions. ## 🗑️ Uninstall When you uninstall FontEF Pro, ALL files, backups, temp data, overlay data and SD card files are completely removed. Zero traces left. ## 📜 Changelog ### v1.0 - Initial release - Universal font replacement - 8 languages - Auto dark/light theme - meta-overlayfs support - Universal KSU root bridge ## 🔗 Links - 📱 Telegram: [@DeZ4p](https://t.me/DeZ4p) - 📦 Releases: [Download](https://github.com/DeZ4p/fontef-pro/releases) - 🌐 CDN: [fontef-cdn](https://github.com/DeZ4p/fontef-cdn) ## 📄 License MIT License

readmeHTML:
🔤 FontEF Pro

Professional Font Manager Module for KernelSU

![Version](https://github.com/DeZ4p/fontef-pro/releases)

![KernelSU](https://kernelsu.org)

![Telegram](https://t.me/DeZ4p)

---

Change your Android system font with a beautiful WebUI

✨ Features

  • 🎯 Universal font replacement for ALL Android devices
  • 🌐 Online WebUI (always up-to-date)
  • 🌙 Auto Dark / Light theme
  • 🔍 Universal root bridge (works on all devices)
  • 📱 meta-overlayfs support
  • 🛡️ susfs4ksu compatible
  • 🔄 Remote config updates (no reinstall needed)
  • 👁️ Live font preview with size control
  • 📊 Device info display
  • 💾 Backup and Restore
  • 🗑️ Complete uninstall cleanup (zero traces)

    • 🌍 Supported Languages

    🇺🇸 English | 🇮🇷 فارسی | 🇸🇦 العربية | 🇷🇺 Русский | 🇮🇩 Indonesia | 🇮🇳 हिंदी | 🇹🇷 Türkçe | 🇩🇪 Deutsch

    📱 Supported Devices

  • Xiaomi / Poco / Redmi (MIUI, HyperOS)
  • Samsung (One UI)
  • OnePlus / Oppo / Realme (OxygenOS, ColorOS)
  • Google Pixel (Pixel UI)
  • Huawei / Honor (EMUI, HarmonyOS)
  • TECNO / Infinix (HiOS)
  • Any AOSP / Custom ROM (LineageOS, crDroid, PixelOS)

    • 📥 Installation

  • Download the latest ZIP from [Releases](../../releases)
  • Open KernelSU app
  • Install module (flash ZIP)
  • Reboot your device
  • Open KernelSU → Modules → FontEF Pro → WebUI
  • Upload a font file (.ttf or .otf)
  • Tap Apply Font
  • Reboot again

    • 🔄 Auto Update

    FontEF Pro supports KernelSU auto-update. The module automatically checks for new versions.

    🗑️ Uninstall

    When you uninstall FontEF Pro, ALL files, backups, temp data, overlay data and SD card files are completely removed. Zero traces left.

    📜 Changelog

    v1.0

  • Initial release
  • Universal font replacement
  • 8 languages
  • Auto dark/light theme
  • meta-overlayfs support
  • Universal KSU root bridge

    • 🔗 Links

  • 📱 Telegram: [@DeZ4p](https://t.me/DeZ4p)
  • 📦 Releases: [Download](https://github.com/DeZ4p/fontef-pro/releases)
  • 🌐 CDN: [fontef-cdn](https://github.com/DeZ4p/fontef-cdn)
